scope: New development diagnostics plus fresh paired confirmation; existing R7 observations informed this design. No claim that the old confirmation is unseen.

fixed_anchor_exchange.brownian_exception: All three Brownian contracts jointly set leak=0. These are not exact killed OU models.
fixed_anchor_exchange.primary_quantity: Exact finite-model greedy return and occupancy-weighted Q-star action regret on the original task; unbounded Gaussian/probit control separately avoids state projection.

calibration.training_configurations: Eight original R7 public configurations only
calibration.reference: Independent fixed-cell product-state optimal Bellman recursion; full legal successor distribution
calibration.loss_weights: 90% mixture of fixed baseline/optimal occupancy plus 10% uniform legal-state coverage
calibration.transition_encoder: Frozen separate kernel_content branch; drive and core remain frozen. Stage two is content/readout joint calibration, not joint cell optimization.
calibration.selection: Final fixed-budget step, no best-checkpoint or heldout selection
calibration.controls: Apply the identical schedule and reference generation to direct, projected Gaussian, clocked and first-passage families.

confirmation.configuration_source: protocol.py; new heldout combinations frozen before their execution
confirmation.pairing: Same private world and public task budget, keyed latent uniforms; randomized arm order
confirmation.arms: Four families times baseline/readout/content_readout in hard deployment; corresponding mean policies; task DP and myopic DP; common-anchor Brownian projected three-contract controls and exact unbounded endpoint hard/mean.
confirmation.inference: Report all five fit-level paired differences and the enumerated fit-cluster bootstrap (5^5 resamples). The three primary contrasts in each of two regimes form six tests and use 99.166667% intervals; secondary contrasts use descriptive 95% intervals. This multiplicity clarification is frozen before any fresh confirmation or heldout execution. Five fits limit inferential strength.
confirmation.utility: Task return - 0.0005 decisions - 0.0002 model events. Fees are proxies, separately from measured runtime.
confirmation.failures: Retain every attempted arm and report any operational failure; no silent drop, no post-confirmation selection.

numerics.reference: Stable CDF/interval arithmetic, independent SciPy quadrature/flux, short exact branches and finite differences
numerics.critical_corner: Brownian upper hit: drift=1, sigma=0.05, boundary=1, x=0, dt=0.8
numerics.recovery: q(dt)=1-exp(-lambda dt), lambda=-log(1-q_ref)/dt_ref; event freezes remainder of tick, old refractory mass releases at tick end
numerics.claims: Finite image truncation, voltage projection, and tick semantics remain explicit. No continuous OU or multiple-within-tick firing equivalence claim.

native.execution: Encode, propagate, sample and read out inside real NeuronModelPort; chosen action drives unchanged READ/STOP artifact broker.
native.state: Model/source/schema identity, latent mass, RNG seed/counter, owner journal/anchor and acknowledged checkpoint
native.acceptance: Python/Rust numerical and selected-action parity; cold-process acknowledged recovery; component costs plus IPC/artifact/full episode; no claim of arbitrary crash atomicity.

publication: Freeze source and completed candidate identities before fresh confirmation. Preserve unsuccessful diagnostics and publish evidence in a new branch without changing R7.
